Title: Human Liver Microsomal Stability
Description: Indicates whether a compound is likely to be cleared rapidly by human liver microsomes, the usual first checkpoint for metabolic stability; a half-life at or below 30 minutes counts as unstable. This is the earlier ADME@NCATS classifier (2022): a graph neural network that takes a rat microsomal prediction as an extra input, trained on roughly 4,300 in-house NCATS compounds. The cited 2024 paper benchmarks this approach on a larger dataset and describes its XGBoost successor. Microsomes carry phase I oxidation only, so cytosolic and conjugative routes stay invisible.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound is unstable in human liver microsomes, meaning a half-life of 30 minutes or less.
